Michael —

Thanks for the quick kickoff yesterday. We're ready to align on the post-signature execution plan. Internal priorities: minimum downtime for our ingestion pipeline, a clear canary window, and instructor-led training for our ops team.

Can you send a draft MAP that embeds the rollout + canary + migration + training steps and a short timeline we can share with our security review? We'll need:

- Staging validation checklist
- Training dates (2 half days ideally)
- Acceptance criteria for sign-off

Also flag any gating items that could push the close beyond the end of June. Our procurement team is keen to have implementation milestones in the contract exhibit.

Thanks,
Jared

Jared —

Appreciate the clear asks. I've attached a working MAP (MAP_v1.pdf) that folds the implementation plan into the mutual action plan you can attach to procurement. High level below; full details are in the attachment.

Summary (draft):
- Week 0 (prep): contract countersigned, staging access and test dataset provisioned, API keys for Novapulse test org created.
- Week 1-2 (canary): small traffic slice (5-10%) routed to Redwood staging cluster; 72-hour continuous monitoring window + 24-hour extended validation.
- Week 3 (migration): progressive traffic ramp from 10% -> 100% with automated rollback at predetermined thresholds.
- Week 4 (training & handoff): two half-day training sessions + runbook handover and key-user acceptance testing (UAT).

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- 99th percentile inference latency within agreed SLA for 72-hour canary window
- Error rate for inference requests < 0.3% over monitoring window
- Successful execution of smoke test suite (10 representative prompts) during canary

Open asks for Novapulse:
1) Confirm canary window (preferred: Jun 6–12) or suggest alternatives.
2) Provide 3 contacts for training + preferred time zone.
3) Confirm whether audit logs must be retained for 12 vs 24 months (affects storage provisioning).

Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf (1-page MAP + milestones)

I'll follow up with Marissa to add operational canary thresholds and Laura to propose training slots we can lock into the MAP.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Customer Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Looping in the operational details we discussed. I added a canary checklist and rollback triggers; please see the attached canary-checklist.md. Key items:

Pre-canary smoke tests (to run 48 hours prior):
- Synthetic throughput test at 1.5x expected baseline
- KV-cache warmup validation for long-context flows
- End-to-end request/response parity against control model

Monitoring thresholds (automated alerts):
- Latency P95 > baseline + 60ms -> page on-call and pause ramp
- Error rate > 0.5% for 15m -> auto-rollback to previous route
- Token generation divergence (semantic drift) flagged by eval set failing 2/3 checks -> hold and investigate

Rollback protocol (summary):
1) Pause traffic ramp, continue monitoring for 30 minutes.
2) If issues persist, re-route traffic to previous model variant and open incident.
3) Post-mortem within 48 hours; decision on repeat canary or modified plan.

Attachment: canary-checklist.md (text, ~2 pages)

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Platform Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
